step1.title: Executive hospital status
step1.narrative: Start with the executive dashboard for organization-wide KPIs, trends, and the current operational situation across all hospitals.

step2.title: Critical operational issue
step2.narrative: Review open alerts to triage critical and warning issues by domain, hospital, and severity before they escalate.

step3.title: Bed management drill-down
step3.narrative: Drill into bed occupancy, the live bed board, and operational lists for patients awaiting admission or discharge.

step4.title: Emergency crowding prediction
step4.narrative: Use AI-assisted ED crowding intelligence to anticipate bottlenecks and plan staffing and flow interventions.

step5.title: Business Data Copilot
step5.narrative: Ask questions in plain language and receive answers, charts, and tables grounded in your hospital data warehouse.

step6.title: Patient 360
step6.narrative: Search the patient registry and open a unified clinical, financial, and utilization profile for any patient.

step7.title: Data quality issue
step7.narrative: Monitor completeness, freshness, and failed checks to ensure dashboards and AI features run on trustworthy data.

step8.title: Universal HIS integration
step8.narrative: Connect source systems, map entities and codes, and certify domains through the onboarding wizard.

step9.title: AI readiness
step9.narrative: Review clinical AI governance, model monitoring, and integration readiness before activating predictive features.

step10.title: Recommended action
step10.narrative: Conclude in the command center — a calm, full-screen view for real-time status, rotation across hospitals, and critical alerts.

descriptions.reconciliation: Compare source counts with loaded warehouse records.
descriptions.dashboardReadiness: Review dashboard readiness scores per domain.
descriptions.aiReadiness: Review AI feature readiness and validation status.
descriptions.certifyDomain: Obtain business and clinical sign-off per domain.
descriptions.activateFeatures: Enable dashboards and AI features via feature gating.

dataPlatform.title: Data Platform
dataPlatform.subtitle: Airbyte ingestion, Dagster orchestration, and OpenMetadata governance for the medallion pipeline
dataPlatform.flowDiagram:
Hospital sources → Airbyte (EL) → Raw schema
                              ↓
                    Dagster medallion_elt_job
                              ↓
              Bronze → Silver → Gold → Dashboards & AI
                              ↓
              OpenMetadata (catalog, lineage, quality)
dataPlatform.quickStartCommands:
make data-platform-up          # Dagster + OpenMetadata
make data-platform-roles       # DB roles for Airbyte & OMD
make airbyte-up                # Airbyte on http://localhost:8001 (not :8000)
make dagster-materialize       # Run medallion ELT job

airbyte.name: Airbyte
airbyte.description: Connect hospital sources and load batches into the Raw schema. Airbyte does not write Bronze, Silver, or Gold.

dagster.name: Dagster
dagster.description: Runs the medallion_elt_job: Raw readiness → Bronze → Silver → Gold materialization and scheduling.

openMetadata.name: OpenMetadata
openMetadata.description: Discover Postgres medallion tables, document pipelines, and trace lineage across Raw through Gold.

openMetadata.integrationDisabled: OpenMetadata integration is disabled. Set OPENMETADATA_UI_INTEGRATION_ENABLED=true on the backend and VITE_OPENMETADATA_UI_INTEGRATION_ENABLED=true for the frontend build.
